arguments.query: SELECT o.order_ts,o.status,o.channel,i.quantity,i.unit_price_cents,p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) LIMIT 8
SELECT channel,status,count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, sum(t.amt)/100.0 total, sum(t.amt)/100.0/count(*) aov FROM (SELECT o.order_id, sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents) amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.channel='app' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-07-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.order_id) t
